name: earth genasi
special_features: Glistening ore veins, gem-like eyes, dust trail
age: Same as humans, up to 120 years
lore:
To understand the Earth Genasi is to grasp the slow, inexorable patience of the mountain. They are the children of the deep places, carrying the weight and majesty of the world within their very marrow.

### Appearance
An Earth Genasi’s form is a living testament to the lithic world. Their skin may possess the matte texture of sun-baked clay, the rugged grain of granite, or the polished sheen of obsidian. Often, their flesh is traced with veins of precious ore or crystalline growths that shimmer under torchlight. Their eyes typically resemble unrefined gemstones—deep emeralds, smoldering garnets, or cold sapphires—set into faces that appear carved by time itself. Many exude the sharp scent of petrichor or fresh-turned earth, and some leave a faint trail of dust in their wake, as if the desert winds follow them.

### Origins
These beings are born where the Elemental Plane of Earth brushes against our own. Most trace their lineage to the Dao—the imperious genies of the Sevenfold Hoard—whose potent essence lingers in mortal bloodlines for generations. Others are forged by proximity to ancient earthen rifts, their spirits calcified by the raw power of the subterranean deeps. They are the mountain’s heartbeat given human shape.

### Culture
Culturally, they are the bedrock of any society they inhabit. Earth Genasi value permanence and craftsmanship, often excelling as master architects, miners, or jewelers. They are not easily moved to haste or anger, but once stirred, their resolve is as devastating as an avalanche. They possess a rhythmic sense of time, viewing life not in fleeting moments, but in eras. Stoic and reliable, they remain profoundly connected to the bones of the world, serving as the immovable foundations of their communities.
